mini1b.description: 14-layer (2x6 cycles + 2 remainder) MQA Gemma 3 1B mini-twin with sliding_window=4, non-zero RMSNorm weights, tied embeddings, and right-padding + SWA locality probes.

minigqa.description: 8-layer (1x6 cycle + 2 remainder) GQA Gemma 3 4B/12B/27B mini-twin with linear RoPE scaling (factor=8.0), query_pre_attn_scalar=12 != head_dim=8, final logit softcapping, and untied lm_head.

reference.description: Unmodified Hugging Face transformers==4.57.3 (torch==2.14.0+cpu) transformers.models.gemma3 Gemma3TextConfig + Gemma3ForCausalLM in eager float32.
